candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the public getter never reflects call timestamps.
Delete the timestamp guard `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` so multiple calls in the same block/timestamp succeed and update `pastBlockTime` differently.
Delete the value check `require(msg.value == 10 ether);` so calls with other values succeed and update `pastBlockTime`.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the stored value is a block number rather than a timestamp.
Delete the payout statement so the contract never transfers its balance to the caller.
Replace the payout condition `block.number % 15 == 0` with `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting when the transfer occurs.
Remove the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check so the function updates pastBlockTime even when called again in the same block instead of reverting.
Remove the assignment pastBlockTime = block.timestamp so the stored value is never updated after a successful call.
Store block.number instead of block.timestamp into pastBlockTime, changing the value exposed by the public getter.
Set pastBlockTime to 0 instead of block.timestamp so the getter always reads zero after a call.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether); statement so calls with any value are accepted instead of reverting.
Change the timestamp guard to require(block.timestamp < pastBlockTime), reversing the time-window condition.
Delete the statement pastBlockTime = block.timestamp; so the public getter pastBlockTime() never updates after a call.
Change the payout condition to if(block.number % 15 != 0) so payouts happen on blocks not divisible by 15.
Replace pastBlockTime = block.timestamp; with pastBlockTime = block.number; so the stored value (observable via the public getter and the guard) differs.
Delete the entire if block containing the payout transfer so the contract never returns funds to the caller.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check so calls with any value succeed and update pastBlockTime.
Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check so repeated calls in the same block no longer revert.
Change the timestamp comparison operator from > to >=.
Delete the assignment pastBlockTime = block.timestamp so pastBlockTime never changes after a call.
Replace the assignment pastBlockTime = block.timestamp with pastBlockTime = block.number.
Change the required deposit from 10 ether to 1 ether so calls with other values are accepted.
